signal: XOi launched Advisor, an AI-driven asset intelligence solution for field-service sales teams, and partnered with Bluon and Blue Frontier, while earning 2026 Capterra and Software Advice awards for field service management.

email.body1:
Coleman, saw XOi launch Advisor and pick up the Bluon and Blue Frontier partnerships alongside the 2026 field-service awards.

When the product and partner story moves that fast, more contractors and service orgs are worth a conversation than any BDR can personally work, and good accounts slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new hires: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for XOi off your launch and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Coleman, quick follow-up for XOi.

With Advisor and new partnerships live, more field-service orgs are in-market than the team can touch, and most BDR teams do not know how many meetings they actually need to book to hit the number. The gap shows up late, and then it is a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings XOi needs to hit target this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Coleman, last bit of proof for XOi.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how XOi's reply rate likely compares to other field-service-tech companies. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Coleman, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Launching a new AI product and partnerships is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a field-service motion? I will tailor it to XOi either way.
